note: Large forested Alberta Parks recreation area campground at Franchere Bay on Moose Lake, beside Moose Lake Provincial Park: sites in the woods behind a sandy swimming beach, with a boat launch, pier, fish-cleaning stations and a camp store selling ice cream. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (Apr 23, 2026) and shop: May 14 - Sep 8, 197 sites (107 unserviced C$26, 50 power C$34, 40 power/water C$42, 15/30-amp), reservable, showers/flush toilets/store/dump; added counts, lengths, facilities. WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview recommended (every site 'Near Water - no'; nearest pads 20-35 m from the water through a spruce belt).
flags: WATERFRONT (recommend lakefront -> lakeview): the March 2026 campground map (https://www.albertaparks.ca/media/hskb32q4/moose-lake-franchere-bay-tear-sheet.pdf, 50 m scale bar) puts the nearest sites, 190-198 on the small east loop south of the beach, with a wooded strip and no road between them and Moose Lake. On Esri imagery (0.9 m/px) those pads are ~20-35 m from the water but under a continuous spruce/aspen belt that runs to the shoreline; site 198, the northernmost, is beside the south end of the open beach. The shop marks every one of the 197 sites 'Near Water - no'. The rest of the campground sits 100-500 m back in forest. Not open ground to the water, so not lakefront; lakeview for the east-loop sites at best.
